title: Willy Wonka would love this laboratory that checks the quality of chocolate
summary: The chocolate biz is raising the bar with a lab to assess cacao beans from around the world. (Talk about a sweet gig!) Consumers and farmers stand to benefit from the "Standard of Excellence" program.
contentText:
